title: The price is a lie: landed cost
hook_variants: That ten dollar product on Alibaba? It's not ten dollars.
Every beginner seller makes this mistake. It kills their profit.
The price you see is never the price you pay.

scenes.say: That ten dollar product on Alibaba? It's not ten dollars.
Pros call the real number the landed cost. It's literally my name.
Ten for the product. One fifty for freight. A bit of insurance. Two in duties. One in port and broker fees.
Landed cost: fourteen seventy. That's forty-seven percent more than the sticker.
scenes.label: REAL COST PER UNIT

scenes.say: Sell it for twenty and you think you make ten. You really make about five.
Never price from the sticker. Price from the landed cost.
Follow Landed Costs before you import anything.

caption:
Product + freight + insurance + duty + fees = LANDED COST. Price from that, not the sticker. 📦

Save this before your first import.
